metadata.Scope: Study comparison strains named in each row; these are not all Syn61. Growth and Biolog identities are kept separate, with no inferred evolution-stage join.
metadata.Source: Fitness_Source_data, source row encoded in record ID
metadata.Replicates: Ten published measurements per row; independent starter-culture mapping unspecified.
metadata.No growth: Categorical source result; all numeric zero placeholders retained only in the source-cell audit, not interpreted as kinetic measurements.
metadata.Acquisition: Aerobic microplate, 800 rpm, OD600 every nine minutes; GrowthRates 4.4. Long-term no-growth assessment used three cultures over 14 days.

units.value: source-reported Max Height difference (optical-density basis; source wavelength inconsistent)
units.normalization: As deposited; exact background/curve/per-well processing unspecified; source mentions 590 nm and OD600.

metadata.Replicates: Two independent replicate measurements summarized by source; individual replicate values unavailable.
metadata.Summary: No cross-well mean is reported here. Published Table 1 score matches the sum, despite mean wording.
metadata.Identity: Seg80-0 source label retained; equivalence to Seg82-0 unresolved. No cross-assay identity or evolution-stage join.
